# OPAH ONE (design-os-drone-showcase)

> OPAH ONE: a 249-gram drone with a molded guard ring, 4K60 video, and 31-minute flight time. Built with Design:OS — tenant-contract scroll-scrub and GSAP choreography.

An interactive marketing showcase website demonstrating scroll-scrubbed 3D kinematic storytelling, precision typography, and mobile performance verification for the OPAH ONE sub-250g indoor/outdoor drone.

## Documentation & Pages

- [Interactive Showcase](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-drone-showcase/): The primary scroll-scrubbed interactive experience.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-drone-showcase): Project source code, CSS design tokens, and automation scripts.

## Product Specifications

- **Weight**: 249 grams (sub-250g regulatory category, no FAA registration required for recreational flight).
- **Camera**: 4K at 60fps stabilized mechanical gimbal.
- **Flight Time**: Up to 31 minutes per battery charge.
- **Indoor Flight**: Integrated 360-degree molded guard ring for obstacle bounce resilience.
